Welcome to Rajdhani Mattress Mart

Rajdhani Mattress Mart is one of Surat's oldest and most trusted mattress stores. Located in Palanpur Jakat Naka, our shop has been serving customers with high-quality mattresses and curtains since 1970.

Whether you need a specialized orthopedic mattress, a custom size for a unique bed frame, or beautiful new curtains to refresh your home, our expert staff is here to help you find the perfect solution. We are known for our exceptional service, quality products, and reasonable prices.
